columns.name: Location Name
columns.description: The title of the school, park, or building that the event takes place near.

columns.name: Location
columns.description: The location of the Address column in a format that allows for mapping and other geographic analysis on this portal.

columns.name: Boundaries - ZIP Codes
columns.description: This column was automatically created in order to record in what polygon from the dataset 'Boundaries - ZIP Codes' (rpca-8um6) the point in column 'location_otb' is located.  This enables the creation of region maps (choropleths) in the visualization canvas and data lens.
